questions.q: About how much milk can a dairy cow make in one day?
questions.why: The script says a dairy cow can make about 25 liters of milk in one day.

questions.q: About how many eggs does a hen lay in one year?
questions.why: The script says a hen can lay about 300 eggs in one year.

questions.q: A farmer has 6 hens, and each hen lays 1 egg per day. How many eggs do the 6 hens lay in one week?
